issues.message: C4 requires an artifact receipt before ready but C5 creates the local receipt after C4. Specify the exact upstream producer, persistence contract and binding (or move receipt generation before the check), including unavailable handling; keep W1/W2 exception paths coherent.

Successful handoffInput only carries C4.checked metadata, while checked omits the draft text/claim citations and typed domain result. C5 output also lacks review content. Preserve a fully typed reviewedArtifact payload or specify content storage/retrieval by artifactId, freshness/hash binding and domain fields from producer to terminal output. Declare category enum as an actual produced field; EV1 expects category delivery.

EV1/EV17 give prose model responses rather than typed concrete candidates, so a harness must invent payloads. Separate configured responses from expected invocation traces, supply exact candidate outputs and define forbidden calls explicitly.
